missions: Home box: F# minor shape at fret 2
The song is in A major, so you use the F# minor pentatonic box at fret 2. It has the same notes as A major pentatonic. Loop the Verse and start and end every phrase on an A (G string, fret 2).
With "Follow chord" on, land on an amber or red dot on the first beat of each chord: D, Amaj7, A, Dm.
Dm is borrowed from A minor, and its F is the note that makes the song bittersweet. Over Dm, play F (D string, fret 3), then fall one fret to E (fret 2) when A comes back.
Play one phrase that starts in Box 1 (fret 2) and ends in Box 2 (fret 5).
Amaj7 already has color: its G# is the maj7. Hold G# (G string, fret 1) over Amaj7 and resolve up to A over A. Then try D add9 from the Color panel.

special.text: Over Dm, play F on the D string at fret 3, one fret above the box note E. Dm is borrowed from A minor, and F is the note that gives it the sad turn. When A comes back, drop one fret to E: that half-step fall is the sound of this song.

guide.record: Solo over the intro and the D Dm A D riff between choruses, and in the short gaps after sung lines. Keep it soft; it's a ballad.

notes: Key set to A major by hand: the intro and ending settle on A, and Amaj7 (with G#) fits A major, not D major. Dm is borrowed from A minor.
